params.name: userID
params.description: in: unique ID number of the user account to modify, or -1/-2 to add a new user; out: unique ID number of the added/modified user.

sentinelValues.meaning: Add a new user, affiliated with the Designer (binary databases).
Add a new user, affiliated with the Administrator (binary databases only).

params.name: password
params.description: New unencrypted password (4D encrypts it before saving), or the * symbol to leave the existing password unchanged.

sentinelValues.meaning: Leave the account's existing password unchanged.

params.name: nbLogin
params.description: Binary databases only; ignored in project databases.

params.name: lastLogin
params.description: Binary databases only; ignored in project databases.

params.name: groupOwner
params.description: Binary databases only; ID number of the default owner group for objects created by this user.

constraints: The mechanical draft left userID with direction 'in', but the doc's arrow column marks it '<->' (inout): it is both an input (user ID to modify, or -1/-2 to add) and an output (receives the new/modified user's ID number).
If userID is not -1, -2, or a valid existing user ID, the command does nothing.
If the user account does not exist or has been deleted, error -9979 is generated (catchable with ON ERR CALL); check first with Is user deleted.
If name is not unique, the command does nothing and error -9979 is generated.
If memberships is omitted, the user's current memberships are left unchanged (or the new user belongs to no group, when adding); passing an empty memberships array revokes all memberships.
